prompt:
Write a WhatsApp group chat export in Hinglish (Roman script) for a fictional UPI-fraud training case.
Group members (use exactly these names as senders): Divya didi, Tanuja didi, Sunil C., Sunil bhai.
The chat covers 24/03/26, 7:15 pm to 24/03/26, 9:15 pm. It must have exactly 26 message lines, in time order.
Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text
These messages must appear word for word, in this order, with these exact timestamps and senders:
24/03/26, 8:08 pm - Sunil bhai: Divya didi, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.
Fix these problems from your previous attempt:
- F1: chat.txt:14 at 8:02 pm vs calls.csv row 3 at 20:07 differs by 5 min (tolerance 2)
text:
24/03/26, 7:15 pm - Tanuja didi: Suno sab, aaj ke UPI batch ka reconciliation ho gaya kya?
24/03/26, 7:21 pm - Divya didi: Ha Tanuja didi, base files me enter kar diya hai.
24/03/26, 7:26 pm - Sunil C.: Ek 45,000 ka pending entry dikh raha hai portal pe.
24/03/26, 7:31 pm - Sunil bhai: Kon sa entry Sunil? Mujhe text SMS me to 45k received aaya tha.
24/03/26, 7:36 pm - Tanuja didi: Par account statement me credit highlight nahi hua hai abhi tak.
24/03/26, 7:42 pm - Divya didi: Maine QR code scan karke check kiya tha, status processing bol raha tha.
24/03/26, 7:47 pm - Sunil C.: Customer keh raha hai unke side se debit ho gaya hai.
24/03/26, 7:51 pm - Sunil bhai: Unko bolo reference UTR number share karein group pe.
24/03/26, 7:56 pm - Divya didi: UTR matches with the dummy test account we created yesterday.
24/03/26, 7:59 pm - Tanuja didi: Fraud awareness module ke training scenarios check kar rahe hain kya hum?
24/03/26, 8:02 pm - Sunil C.: Haan, standard rollback exercise hai for fake payment links.
24/03/26, 8:04 pm - Divya didi: Lekin wo real account me reflect ho gaya hai 45,000 INR.
24/03/26, 8:06 pm - Sunil C.: Ek sec, customer support ka call aa raha hai exact same transaction pe.
24/03/26, 8:07 pm - Tanuja didi: Call pe baat karke clear karo Sunil C., mismatch nahi hona chahiye.
24/03/26, 8:08 pm - Sunil bhai: Divya didi, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
24/03/26, 8:12 pm - Divya didi: Okay Sunil bhai, log system se remove kar rahi hu.
24/03/26, 8:17 pm - Sunil C.: Phone call pe verify hua, customer scam test transaction ka part tha.
24/03/26, 8:23 pm - Tanuja didi: System log wipe karne se pehle compliance backup liya tha na?
24/03/26, 8:29 pm - Divya didi: Yes didi, screenshot backup drive me saved hai.
24/03/26, 8:36 pm - Sunil bhai: Perfect, security team audit ke liye mang sakti hai.
24/03/26, 8:43 pm - Sunil C.: Next case study standard phish-link spoofing ka handle karenge.
24/03/26, 8:50 pm - Tanuja didi: Sabhi training documents shared folder me update kar do.
24/03/26, 8:56 pm - Divya didi: Sheet me updated entries upload kar di hain maine.
24/03/26, 9:02 pm - Sunil bhai: Aaj ki final report manager ko mail kar deta hu.
24/03/26, 9:08 pm - Sunil C.: Done, session wrap up karte hain phir.
24/03/26, 9:14 pm - Tanuja didi: Good night team, kal subah 10 baje review meeting hai.
